master.definition_en: Malaria is a serious and sometimes fatal disease caused by a parasite that commonly infects a certain type of mosquito which feeds on humans. Infection with malaria parasites may result in a wide variety of symptoms, ranging from absent or very mild symptoms to severe disease and even death. People who get malaria are typically very sick with high fevers, shaking chills, and flu-like illness. In general, malaria is a curable disease if diagnosed and treated promptly and correctly.Treatment depends on many factors including disease severity, the species of malaria parasite causing the infection and the part of the world in which the infection was acquired.

curated.lethality_detail_zh: 按蚊叮咬传播疟原虫，其中恶性疟原虫增殖迅速且阻塞脑及器官微循环；若未能尽早识别给药，重症脑型疟可在起病数日乃至24–48小时内因昏迷、惊厥、严重溶血性贫血、酸中毒或急性肾衰竭死亡。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 青蒿素联合疗法（ACT）及重症静脉注射青蒿琥酯可迅速杀灭血内疟原虫，早期诊断与足疗程用药可实现100%寄生虫清除治愈；延误诊治的输入性恶性疟仍是我国输入性传染病的重要死因。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 对所有非洲/东南亚归国不明原因高热者第一时间询问疫区史并立即行血涂片镜检与疟原虫RDT快检；确诊重症疟疾或脑型疟立即静脉注射青蒿琥酯（2.4 mg/kg首剂，随后12h、24h及每日一次直到可口服，完成后接续完整3日口服ACT疗程）；同步防治低血糖、高热惊厥、重度贫血（输血）、肺水肿及急性肾损伤；轻症非复杂恶性疟即刻口服ACT。

master.definition_en: The metabolic condition resulted from uncontrolled diabetes mellitus, in which the shift of acid-base status of the body toward the acid side because of loss of base or retention of acids other than carbonic acid is accompanied by the accumulation of ketone bodies in body tissues and fluids.

aliases_zh: 糖尿病急性高血糖危象
curated.lethality_detail_zh: 严重胰岛素缺乏联合升糖激素急剧升高，导致高血糖、渗透性利尿脱水、脂肪分解产生大量酮体及严重代谢性酸中毒；未及时抢救可在数小时至数日内因低血容量性休克、恶性高/低钾心律失常、脑水肿（儿童尤高危）或呼吸循环衰竭死亡。
curated.treatability_summary_zh: 属于可完全逆转的急性代谢危象；在规范执行补液、小剂量胰岛素持续静滴、精确补钾及消除感染等诱因后，绝大多数患者可在24-72小时内纠酸脱险，总体住院生存率超95%，但合并重症脓毒症、脑水肿或高龄2型糖尿病患者死亡风险显著上升。

annual_deaths_global.range_or_note: WHO及GBD死因分类将DKA归并入“糖尿病”总体死亡统计，未单列全球独立死亡数；临床队列显示发达地区成人DKA住院病死率<1%-2%，医疗欠发达地区及儿童脑水肿相关病死率显著更高

annual_deaths_china.range_or_note: 国家死因监测未单列DKA独立年死亡总数；中国三甲多中心研究显示整体住院病死率约1.7%，其中2型糖尿病合并DKA住院病死率约3.2%

epidemiology.prevalence_global: 全球Meta分析显示1型糖尿病患者初诊时即表现为DKA的比例高达41.9%，是儿童青少年及青年糖尿病最主要急性首发危象。
epidemiology.prevalence_china: 中国新发1型糖尿病患者DKA起病比例高，约40%的住院DKA由感染诱发，其次为胰岛素治疗中断或减量不当；SGLT2抑制剂广泛应用后正常血糖型DKA占比有所上升。

clinical_management.acute_emergency_protocol_zh: 标准四步抢救方案：1) 首要补液：前1-2小时静脉输入0.9%氯化钠1000-1500 mL恢复有效血容量，血糖降至13.9 mmol/L以下时加用5%葡萄糖盐水；2) 胰岛素治疗：确认血钾≥3.3 mmol/L后予0.1 U/kg/h短效人胰岛素持续静脉泵入至酮体转阴、酸中毒纠正；3) 严密监测并见尿补钾，防止溶酸后低血钾致心搏骤停；4) 积极抗感染及原发病处置，仅在pH<6.9时谨慎小剂量补碱。

research_progress.breakthroughs_and_trials_zh: 近年来全球内分泌与急救指南（2024 ADA/EASD/JBDS共识及中国DKA规范）重点推广连续性血β-羟丁酸床旁监测、平衡晶体液（乳酸林格/醋酸平衡液）替代大剂量纯生理盐水以减少高氯性酸中毒与缩短ICU住院时间；SGLT2抑制剂相关正常血糖型DKA（euDKA）早识别流程及家庭血酮监测普及显著降低再入院率。
research_progress.key_unmet_needs_zh: 1) 初发儿童1型糖尿病“以DKA起病”比例在基层及全球仍居高不下，亟待提升早期高血糖警觉与胰岛自身抗体筛查；2) SGLT2抑制剂围手术期或感染期停药宣教不足导致正常血糖DKA误诊延误；3) 基层急诊频繁血气及血酮动态监测可及性不均。

master.name_en: acute myeloid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndromes related to alkylating agent
master.definition_en: Acute myeloid leukemia and myelodysplastic syndromes related to alkylating agent is a subgroup of therapy-related myeloid neoplasms (t-MN), associated with a treatment of an unrelated neoplastic or autoimmune disease with cytotoxic agents, like cyclophosphamid, platins, melphalan and others. The neoplastic cells typically harbor unbalanced aberrations of chromosomes 5 and 7 (monosomy 5/del(5q) and monosomy 7/del(7q)) or a complex karyotype. master.definition_en: A rare, primary cutaneous T-cell lymphoma characterized by solitary cutaneous nodule or only regional disease, typically occurring on the head and neck, and involving entire dermis. Hypoplasia of lower leg muscles is a frequently associated finding. Patients may present with other low-limb malformations, such as patellar hypoplasia, oblique talus, tibial hemimelia, and polydactyly.

master.definition_en: A form of pontocerebellar hypoplasia characterized by infantile onset of severe global developmental delay with absent speech, hypotonia, feeding problems, dysmorphic craniofacial features, and development of pontocerebellar hypoplasia on brain imaging later in childhood. Other structural abnormalities of the brain, which may already be apparent at an earlier stage, include small hippocampus, thin corpus callosum, periventricular white matter abnormalities, and Dandy-Walker malformation. Seizures, nystagmus, and cortical visual impairment have been reported in some cases.

master.definition_en: Isolated sternocostoclavicular hyperostosis is a rare rheumatologic disease characterized by predominantly bilateral, chronic, sterile inflammation and progressive sclerosis and hyperostosis of the sternocostoclavicular joint, with adjacent soft tissue ossification, in the absence of other joint involvement. Peritoneal carcinomatosis can happen in many types of cancer, but it is most common in people with cancers of the ovary, colon, rectum, stomach, pancreas, or appendix.
